head_commit.message:
Merge upstream/main into accessibility-changes

Resolved conflicts in:
- Cargo.lock: accepted upstream schannel 0.1.28
- tui/Cargo.toml: accepted upstream workspace dependency format
- tui/src/cli.rs: merged both --no-animations and --add-dir flags
- tui/src/lib.rs: merged both accessibility and additional_dirs modules
- tui/src/shimmer.rs: merged all imports (animations_enabled, color blend, terminal palette)
- tui/src/status_indicator_widget.rs: merged both animations_enabled and show_interrupt_hint fields
- tui/src/new_model_popup.rs: removed (deleted upstream)

Preserved PR review simplifications:
- CLI-only approach for animation control (no screen reader detection)
- Uses AtomicBool for thread-safe CLI flag state

All tests pass (460/460 when run sequentially).

Fixed error handling in `insert_history_lines_to_writer` where all
terminal operations were silently ignoring errors via `.ok()`.

  ## Why?
Silent I/O failures could leave the terminal in an inconsistent state
(e.g., scroll region not reset) with no way to debug. This violates Rust
error handling best practices.

  ## How?
  - Changed function signature to return `io::Result<()>`
  - Replaced all `.ok()` calls with `?` operator to propagate errors
- Added `tracing::warn!` in wrapper function for backward compatibility
  - Updated 15 test call sites to handle Result  with `.expect()`

head_commit.message:
fix(tui): propagate errors in insert_history_lines_to_writer (#4266)

## What?
Fixed error handling in `insert_history_lines_to_writer` where all
terminal operations were silently ignoring errors via `.ok()`.

  ## Why?
Silent I/O failures could leave the terminal in an inconsistent state
(e.g., scroll region not reset) with no way to debug. This violates Rust
error handling best practices.

  ## How?
  - Changed function signature to return `io::Result<()>`
  - Replaced all `.ok()` calls with `?` operator to propagate errors
- Added `tracing::warn!` in wrapper function for backward compatibility
  - Updated 15 test call sites to handle Result  with `.expect()`

  ## Testing
  - ✅ Pass all tests

  ## Type of Change
  - [x] Bug fix (non-breaking change)

---------
